title: DeepScale
description: Dynamically scales block hardness based on depth (Y-level). Experience realistic mining where the deeper you go, the tougher the crust becomes. Highly lightweight and modular.
body:
# ⛏️ DeepScale | Dynamic Mining Difficulty

**DeepScale** is a lightweight gameplay enhancement mod that dynamically adjusts the hardness of stone-type blocks based on their **Y-level (depth)**. 

In vanilla Minecraft, stone is just as easy to break at the surface as it is near bedrock. DeepScale changes this by simulating geological pressure: the deeper you descend, the tougher the earth becomes.

---

### ✨ Features

*   📈 **Pressure Scaling:** Blocks gradually become harder to mine as you go deeper. Surface mining remains fast, while deep underground exploration requires more effort.
*   💎 **Meaningful Progression:** High-tier pickaxes and Efficiency enchantments become essential for deep-slate layers, giving more value to late-game gear.
*   ⚙️ **Zero-Waste Design:** True to our modular philosophy, this mod adds **zero new blocks or items.** It modifies existing mechanics seamlessly and keeps your inventory clean.
*   🌍 **Universal Compatibility:** Designed to work with modded pickaxes and various stone types from other mods.

---

### 🚜 How it Works

*   **Surface Level:** Standard vanilla mining speed.
*   **Deep Underground:** As you pass Y=0 and head towards bedrock, geological pressure increases block resistance.
*   **Bedrock Proximity:** The world feels solid and challenging. Only the strongest tools will maintain peak efficiency here.

---

### 🛠️ Technical Info
*   **Platform:** Fabric
*   **Version:** 1.21.11
*   **Dependencies:** Fabric API
